entities.name: William Lewis Herndon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William Lewis Herndon was an American naval officer and explorer. In 1851 he led a United States expedition to the Valley of the Amazon, and prepared a report published in 1854 and distributed widely as Exploration of the Valley of the Amazon.
